name: epic
description: A body of work in an issue tracker that serves an objective.

aiGuidance.purpose: Mirrors one tracker epic so the roadmap can say which objective it serves; the issue stays the place where work is discussed.
aiGuidance.extraction: issue_ref is repo#number of the epic issue. Link the objective with a serves relation; an epic with none is parked.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Do not copy the issue's checklist or status.
